From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: POC observability plan — success criteria & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the high-level goals for the POC. Per our discussion, I pulled together a proposed observability plan and success criteria to keep the evaluation focused and measurable. Please review and flag anything you want changed.

Proposed success criteria (pass/fail):
- Stability: No unhandled service errors > 1% of requests during a 24h test window.
- Quality: Model response degradation ≤ 5% vs baseline on our shared eval prompts (we'll ship eval set).
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end latency under 300ms for standard chat flows (see note on traffic shaping).
- Cost: Per-token cost for inference < $0.0008 under test batching profile.

Evaluation plan / what we'll provide:
- Dashboards: Pre-built Grafana dashboard template (latency percentiles, QPS, error rates, model token counts).
- Tracing: Example OpenTelemetry span definitions and a recommended sampler for traces tied to slow requests.
- Logs: Structured request + response metadata export (redacted PII) to your logging endpoint (S3/CloudWatch/BigQuery).
- Metrics: Token-level counters, model inference time, KV cache hit rate, batching efficiency, queue latency.
- Rollout: Start with a 1% traffic canary for two business days, then 10% for three days, then scale to full test if stable.

Proposed owners & timelines:
- Redwood (Marissa / Jordan): deliver dashboard + tracing templates by 2026-10-05.
- FinTechX (Alex / Priya): provide eval prompts, access to a staging logging endpoint, and a point-of-contact for network/firewall rules by 2026-10-08.
- Eng/Infra (Marcus): integrate trace export and metrics in the POC environment; target completion 2026-10-10.

Next steps:
- I'll attach the checklist and the dashboard template. Let's pencil in a sync on 2026-10-12 to review initial telemetry and make any adjustments.

Attachments: poc-observability-checklist.xlsx (checklist), redwood-observability-dashboard-template.json (Grafana/metrics mapping), arch-diagram.png

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — this is really helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Latency: we can confirm the 95th < 300ms target for standard chat flows is acceptable. Can you confirm whether that includes network overhead to our staging VPC, or is it strictly inference time? If possible we'd like both breakdowns (inference-only and end-to-end).
- Dashboards: can you also include a "cost per 1k tokens" panel and an exportable CSV of daily cost estimates during the test window?
- Tracing: we use Honeycomb internally; will your OpenTelemetry spans map cleanly to Honeycomb's trace view?

We'll share the eval prompt set and a staging logging endpoint by 2026-10-06. Also, small ask: can Redwood provide a short sample of span names/attributes we should expect so our observability team can map them to existing dashboards ahead of time?

On the owners/timeline — Alex will be the POC technical lead and Priya will coordinate procurement/network for the logging endpoint.
